description: Forget underground -- feel the breeze commuting on the open road. We'll zip you home and back or zag you through town on the LONDON Citizen E-Bike. If you like some serious pep with your zip, this sleek, compact, folding electric bicycle sports a pedal assist and throttle e-bike system for those extra oomphs and amps. It's a folding electric bike for going and being human. Show us what you got LONDON! Featuring a compact 20" alloy frame with a cleverly hidden, seatpost integrated battery pack -- LONDON packs down tightly for easy commuting, travel and storage. Hidden, seatpost integrated battery Max speed 15.5 mph Max distance 25+ mi depending on assist level Battery Samsung 36 V 7 AH Motor 350 W high speed rear motor Charge time 3 hours Standard Battery Assist Level Range (miles)* ECO 25 Normal 24 Medium 21 Power 18 Turbo 15 Throttle only 15 Extended Range Battery Assist Level Range (miles)* ECO 50 Normal 48 Medium 42 Power 36 Turbo 30 Throttle only 30 Powerful and compact everyday ride A powerful, high speed 350W motor integrated in the rear hub along with a 7-speed drives the LONDON Citizen E-Bike up and down and around. A Samsung 36V battery pack is sneakily hidden inside your seatpost. It's easily removable and can be charged in or out of the bike. Stretch your adventure or ease your commute with the this complete e-bike package. Commuting ready -- ride, fold, roll and go. Get ready for your new cockpit (USB charging included)! Key features Alloy 20" 7spd 39lbs 36 V 350 W 20 mph 25+ mi Looking for something smaller? Check out the compact, mini muni commuting dynamo LIL LONDON electric folding bike for $999. The LIL' LONDON is our wee-version of the LONDON Citizen E-Bike for getting you there in a zap. 16" LIL LONDON $999
